primary_gt.consistency_note: All five event-day precipitation summaries are below 1 mm while the phreatic narrative anchor score is 8, so the computed label is phreatic_report_dry_window.

decision_rule.anchor_score_formula: sum exact counts for phreatic, ash, ballistic, hikers, little warning, unexpectedly
decision_rule.label_rule: phreatic_report_dry_window when max_precip_mm<1.0, anchor_score>=6, and reported_hikers>0
decision_rule.determinism: fixed local files, explicit regular expressions, fixed threshold, and stated numeric tolerances

criteria.name: Output schema
criteria.description: Returns compact JSON with answer, max_precip_mm, dry_margin_mm, sources_below_1mm, anchor_score, reported_hikers, rain_gate, and one calculation-tied note.

criteria.name: Precipitation aggregation
criteria.description: Computes max_precip_mm as 0.536591 mm from the five event-day precipitation summaries, dry_margin_mm as 0.463409 mm, and sources_below_1mm as 5.

criteria.name: Narrative anchor extraction
criteria.description: Uses exact whole-word or phrase counting to get phreatic=2, ash=2, ballistic=1, hikers=1, little_warning=1, unexpectedly=1, anchor_score=8, and reported_hikers=36.

criteria.name: Threshold proof
criteria.description: Applies the 1.0 mm rain threshold, marks rain_gate as fail_lt_1mm, and returns the label phreatic_report_dry_window.

criteria.name: Concise consequence
criteria.description: Keeps the interpretation to a short computed consequence and avoids extra inferences beyond the threshold and count results.

criteria.name: Units and rounding
criteria.description: Reports millimeter values to about 1e-6 precision or an equivalent clearly rounded tolerance.
